notes: Seed snapshot. Build ranges verified against cited sources on verifiedDate. Not exhaustive. Matching rule: for a given product+branch, select the affected entry with the greatest minBuild <= host build (a missing minBuild means 0); the host is exposed if build < fixedBuild. fixedBuild null means no public fix exists for that line (exposed; see entry notes). An optional per-entry 'cves' list means that entry only covers those CVEs; otherwise it covers all CVEs of the advisory. NSX entries use compareBy=version: select by minVersion and compare the dotted version against fixedVersionNumber (NSX build numbers are not monotonic across patch lines). Caveat: ESXi 8.0 GA-line express patches (8.0d/8.0e/8.0f/8.0g, builds 24118393/24569005/24814147/25191479) are not listed in these advisories and are not handled correctly by build comparison. Build-to-version mappings from Broadcom KB 316595 (ESXi) and KB 326316 (vCenter).

lifecycle.notes: No official Broadcom page seen gives the exact EoGS day. A Broadcom VCF blog (https://blogs.vmware.com/cloud-foundation/2025/08/01/sap-customers-running-on-vmware-vsphere-7-call-to-action/) says vSphere 8 'will be supported until October 2027'. Third parties report 2027-10-11 (not verified).
Same as esxi 8.0: Broadcom says EoGS is 'October 2027'; the exact day was not verified on an official page.
The Broadcom EoTG list has one row, 'NSX 4.x', for 4.0/4.1/4.2. No official page with a per-minor EoGS date was found (the Broadcom lifecycle portal is a JavaScript app and could not be read).
NSX-T Data Center 3.2. EoGS is the 'End of Service Date' in KB 421705. The EoTG comes from the 'NSX-T Data Center 3.x' row of the Broadcom EoTG PDF, while KB 421705 only says 'Check Guide'.
